augment_changes: one per copy, picked at random (seed from SEED, image and copy number): JPEG quality 50-90; resize 0.5-0.75x and back; screenshot-style (0.6-0.8x, 2-6% border cut, PNG). Applied before the 512 square + JPEG 90 step; Smaug scores the changed picture
folds: stratified 5-fold (an image and its copies in one fold)
unclear_band: 95th percentile of real out-of-fold combiner scores / 5th percentile of AI ones
